title: Hom components of the four reference tensor-model factors
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a scheme W and flat-term K-flat integral complexes P,Q. The hom of the fixed reference tensor-model isomorphism [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-realizations] equals its four defining factors: total limit applied to the tensor of the reduction-model maps; total limit applied to the inverse representative system tensor model; the reference limit-to-Roos bridge; and localization of Roos applied to the strict tensor-tower map. The ordinary total tensor in the third factor is the actual coefficientTotalTensor, with its sequence-site universes. This is an equation of morphisms in the integral derived category.

theorem pullbackTensorReferenceTensorModel_hom (W : Scheme.{u})
    (P Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory) :
    let T := pullbackTensorCalculus l E W
    let R := (pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    (pullbackTensorReferenceTensorModel l E W P Q).hom =
      (coefficientSequenceLimit l E W).map
        (T.systemClosed.tensor.map
          (Prod.mkHom ((pullbackTensorReductionModel l E W).hom.app P)
            ((pullbackTensorReductionModel l E W).hom.app Q))) ≫
      (coefficientSequenceLimit l E W).map
        (pullbackTensorSystemModel l E W (R.obj P.obj) (R.obj Q.obj)
          (pullbackTensorReductionGood l E W P) (pullbackTensorReductionGood l E W Q)).inv ≫
      (pullbackTensorLimitRoos l E W
        ((coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u}
          (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology W))
          (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E W)).obj (R.obj P.obj, R.obj Q.obj))).hom ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (integralOperationsRoosFunctor.map
        (pullbackTensorTensorTower l E W P.obj Q.obj).hom)
